text:
The 2021 tree-cover loss on ASSET-A is currently **supported** (current version 2, knowledge as of 2026-11-12). It replaces version 1, which was only "pending corroboration" because no later year had yet been observed.

- **Size:** Hansen/UMD maps about 81.3 ha of loss in 2021, or 2.23% of the 3,643.5 ha property. A further 37.3 ha fell in patches under 0.5 ha and is not counted as an event.
- **Corroboration:** Later years of the series (to 2025) were observed. The JRC 2020 forest map agrees on 98% of the event area.
- **Context:** The MGAP 2021 map shows 68.1 ha of planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 0 ha of native forest, and 13.2 ha outside mapped forest.

**Limits:** This does not show deforestation or land-use change, since the loss data also captures plantation cutting. It also does not establish the cause, legality, responsible actor, or any compliance finding.
